page.title: Settings
page.subtitle: Manage your organization settings, integrations, and preferences

featureFlag.title: New Settings UI
featureFlag.subtitle: Toggle to test the new Settings interface
featureFlag.overrideDescription: This override affects only your current browser session. Other users will see the server-configured value from Unleash.
featureFlag.tipDescription: Use this toggle to test the new Settings UI locally without affecting production rollout percentages. Changes take effect immediately after page reload.

clientId.label: Client ID
clientId.description: Unique identifier for your organization. Used for API integrations and analytics tracking.

inviteCode.label: Invite Code
inviteCode.description: Code that users need to provide when registering. Leave empty to disable invite code requirement.

selfRegistration.label: Self-Registration
selfRegistration.description: Allow users to register without an invitation. Configure approval workflow and auto-assignment options.
selfRegistration.requireApproval: Require admin approval before account activation

generalTab.unsavedChanges: You have unsaved changes in General settings. Are you sure you want to leave?

theme.label: Theme
theme.description: Choose the visual theme for your VitalFlow portal. Changes apply immediately.

apiKey.label: OpenAI API Key
apiKey.description: API key for OpenAI integration (kept secure). Your key is encrypted and never exposed in logs.

apiKeyActive.label: API Key Active
apiKeyActive.description: Enable or disable OpenAI integration. Useful for temporary disablement during debugging without deleting the key.

testConnection.tooltip: Test your OpenAI API key connection
testConnection.tooltipSaveFirst: Save your changes first before testing
testConnection.placeholder: Test Connection feature will be implemented in Story 3.5

integrationsTab.unsavedChanges: You have unsaved changes in Integration settings. Are you sure you want to leave?

invite.label: Invite Template
invite.description: Email template sent when inviting a new user to the platform. Use {{name}}, {{inviteCode}}, {{link}} variables.
invite.placeholder: Hi {{name}}, you have been invited to join VitalFlow...

bulkInvite.label: Bulk Invite Template
bulkInvite.description: Email template used for bulk user invitations. Use {{name}}, {{inviteCode}}, {{link}} variables.

resultEmail.label: Result Email Template
resultEmail.description: Email template sent when assessment results are ready. Use {{name}}, {{resultLink}}, {{assessmentType}} variables.

consentForm.label: Consent Form Template
consentForm.description: Digital consent form content displayed to users before assessments. Use {{clinicName}}, {{date}} variables.
consentForm.placeholder: I, the undersigned, consent to participate in...

rom.label: ROM Assessment Template
rom.description: Instructions and description shown at the start of ROM assessments. Use {{patientName}}, {{date}} variables.
rom.placeholder: This assessment will measure your range of motion...

plansTab.title: Plans

defaultPlan.label: Default Plan
defaultPlan.description: Default plan assigned to new users

availablePlans.label: Available Plans
availablePlans.description: Plans that can be selected by users

validation.title: Validation Errors
validation.description: Please fix the errors below before saving.
validation.defaultNotInAvailable: Default plan must be selected in Available Plans
validation.upgradeNotInAvailable: Upgrade plan must be selected in Available Plans
validation.atLeastOne: At least one plan must be available
validation.defaultEqualsUpgrade: Upgrade plan must be different from default plan

plansTab.unsavedChanges: You have unsaved changes in Plans settings. Are you sure you want to leave?

plans.label: Service Plans
plans.description: Manage pricing plans and service packages. Create, edit, or delete plans. Click 'Save Changes' to persist your changes.

modal.nameMinLength: Plan name must be at least 3 characters
modal.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe this plan and its benefits...
modal.pricePositive: Price must be a positive number

delete.title: Delete Plan
delete.description: Are you sure you want to delete this plan?

plans.unsavedChanges: You have unsaved changes to plans. Are you sure you want to leave?

goals.label: Functional Goals
goals.description: Manage rehabilitation and functional goals library. Create, edit, or delete goals. Goals can be categorized for easier organization.
goals.empty: No functional goals yet. Click 'Add Goal' to create one.

modal.titlePlaceholder: e.g. Improve shoulder range of motion
modal.titleMinLength: Title must be at least 3 characters
modal.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe this goal and its purpose...

delete.title: Delete Goal
delete.description: Are you sure you want to delete this goal?

goals.unsavedChanges: You have unsaved changes to functional goals. Are you sure you want to leave?

conditions.label: Pre-existing Conditions
conditions.description: Manage the library of pre-existing medical conditions. Track ICD-10 codes for standardized diagnosis classification.
conditions.empty: No conditions yet. Click 'Add Condition' to create one.

modal.nameMinLength: Name must be at least 3 characters
modal.icd10Invalid: Invalid ICD-10 format (e.g., M15.0 or A00)
modal.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe the condition, symptoms, or clinical notes...

delete.title: Delete Condition
delete.description: Are you sure you want to delete this condition?

conditions.unsavedChanges: You have unsaved changes to pre-existing conditions. Are you sure you want to leave?

unauthorized.title: Unauthorized
unauthorized.subtitle: Super Admin access required for Advanced settings.

bandwidth.label: Bandwidth Optimization
bandwidth.description: Enable bandwidth limits for video uploads and processing to optimize network performance.
bandwidth.validationError: Max upload size must be less than max processing size

tags.label: User Tags
tags.description: Manage tags for organizing users into groups and categories.

delete.title: Delete Tag
delete.description: Are you sure you want to delete this tag?

confirmChanges.title: Confirm Changes
confirmChanges.description: These tag changes affect user organization. Continue?
